name: Sylphia
source:
"I have been ordered by the Goddess to monitor and manage your magical power so that it is not misused."

An angel who values justice and order, and a member of the tribe of angels who monitor the Maou's seal. She was sent by the Goddess to watch the protagonist and manage his magical semen.

To weaken the protagonist's spirit, she became his direct superior and treats him harshly.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/102yojouhan/character02.html]official website[/url]]
